instruction: Use local Qwen through LM Studio to identify the designated blue upright cylinder alphabet_soup proxy and green open basket from enlarged candidate image crops. Execute observe detect identify segment estimate check before motion. Use explicit true false routes for found grasp verified and placement verified. Abort when semantic selection or geometry is missing. No cloud or oracle fallback.

skills.name: perceiving-proxy-objects
skills.description: Local VLM identification and calibrated RGB-D proxy geometry
skills.instructions: The detector proposes up to six colored regions without choosing an object. identify_target and identify_container invoke the loaded local Qwen model and choose a region by its requested description. Their selection controls the mask and depth geometry. Two total local inference calls per episode. There is no color identity fallback and no hosted VLM provider.

actions.name: observe_scene
actions.description: Capture calibrated RGB-D

actions.name: detect_target
actions.description: Detect the configured color in camera pixels

actions.name: segment_target
actions.description: Produce and save a binary image mask

actions.name: estimate_target
actions.description: Reconstruct metric geometry from masked depth

actions.name: check_target
actions.description: Return true only for valid image derived geometry

actions.name: detect_container
actions.description: Detect the configured color in camera pixels

actions.name: segment_container
actions.description: Produce and save a binary image mask

actions.name: estimate_container
actions.description: Reconstruct metric geometry from masked depth

actions.name: check_container
actions.description: Return true only for valid image derived geometry

actions.name: identify_target
actions.description: Use local Qwen to choose a candidate by visual description

actions.name: identify_container
actions.description: Use local Qwen to choose a candidate by visual description

skills.name: grasping-direct-ik
skills.description: Open align descend close and lift with verified physical grasping
skills.instructions: Use the upstream skill guidance but only the deployed aliases below. The binding supplies scene dependent poses and checks holds. Do not invent perception or cuRobo tools. Lift may be included here or in a separate subgraph using this skill.

actions.name: open_gripper
actions.description: Open fingers before approaching

actions.name: align_over_target
actions.description: Move above the target with grasp orientation

actions.name: descend_to_grasp
actions.description: Descend to the grasp pose

actions.name: close_gripper
actions.description: Close with bounded force and verify two finger contact

actions.name: lift_grasped
actions.description: Lift the held object and verify elevation and grasp

actions.name: check_grasp
actions.description: Route on verified two finger contact after closing

skills.name: transporting-objects
skills.description: Transport a verified held object into the basket and release
skills.instructions: The deployed actions resolve poses from the scene. Require lift before transport then position release retract and settle. No direct coordinate editing or physics changes are available.

actions.name: move_over_basket
actions.description: Carry held target over the basket

actions.name: position_for_release
actions.description: Lower held target inside the basket opening

actions.name: release_object
actions.description: Open and verify release

actions.name: retract_from_basket
actions.description: Retract clear of the basket after release

actions.name: settle_release
actions.description: Wait for settling and verify task containment

actions.name: check_placement
actions.description: Route on the unchanged containment and release predicate

limitations: Custom proxy grocery task not an official LIBERO benchmark
Color region proposals are not a general object detector or DINO
Local Qwen identifies candidates while masks remain image color components not SAM
Known cylinder basket dimensions and support plane remain geometry priors
LM Studio must be started manually with the local vision model loaded
Prepared graph adaptation is hand authored not a new model generated revision
